texts:
Week 7 left full-time starters with ugly box scores and handed touchdowns to backups who got the work because someone sat. Every buy and sell for Week 8, with the reasons.

Best buy: #ChiefsKingdom Kenneth Walker III.
Best sell: #TitanUp Tony Pollard.

Let's get to it.

#ChiefsKingdom Kenneth Walker III, KC RB: played 74 percent of the snaps at SEA, about the same share as his last two games, but ran 14 times for 36 in the 20-3 loss.
RB3 rest of season for me. Buy him while his manager stares at 36 yards.

#GoPackGo Matthew Golden, GB WR: has 25 targets over the last two weeks and drew 12 at DET with 165 air yards, on 85 percent of the snaps, but caught 6 for 39.
WR14 rest of season for me, and the targets say higher. Buy him before Wednesday's final injury report.

#RavensFlock Derrick Henry, BAL RB: ran 17 times in each of the last two games and has 103 yards to show for it, on 51 percent of the snaps vs CIN.
RB9 rest of season for me. Buy him before Lamar Jackson is back.

#Saints Chris Olave, NO WR: has drawn 23 targets over the last three games, a 26 percent target share vs PIT, and turned them into 145 yards and one TD.
WR9 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

#Skol Justin Jefferson, MIN WR: drew 29 percent of the targets vs IND and caught 4 for 44. Kyler Murray went 14 of 24 for 150 in that game.
WR11 rest of season for me. Buy him while the quarterback play holds his numbers down.

#FTTB Christian McCaffrey, SF RB: strained his hamstring early at ATL, came back, and still had 13 touches for 100 yards and a TD on 34 snaps. The strain is mild, and he is on track for Week 9 vs LV after the bye.
RB5 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

#WhoDey Chase Brown, CIN RB: 75 percent of the snaps at BAL and 15 touches, but 11 carries for 39 and no score in a 35-13 win. Tennessee comes to Cincinnati Sunday.
RB16 rest of season for me. Buy him before he plays TEN.

#KeepPounding Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR: drew 15 targets over Weeks 6 and 7 and caught 4 for 40 in the 43-13 loss to TB. Bryce Young was pulled early in the fourth quarter with Carolina down 43-6.
WR15 rest of season for me. Buy him before Thursday at GB.

#RaiderNation Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: was back up to 72 percent of the snaps vs LAR after 53 percent and 58 percent, and caught 8 of 8 targets for 61 and a TD.
RB13 rest of season for me. Buy him while his rushing yards look ugly.

#ChiefsKingdom Patrick Mahomes II, KC QB: has no TD pass in two straight games on 63 attempts, and went 19 of 33 for 165 at SEA.
QB12 rest of season for me. Buy him at the low point.

#FTTB Brock Purdy, SF QB: a season-high 40 throws at ATL, then the bye.
QB3 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

George Kittle, SF TE: 24 targets over his last three games.
TE3 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

Now the sells.

#TitanUp Tony Pollard, TEN RB: ran 25 times for 129 and 3 TDs vs CLE on 75 percent of the snaps, with Tyjae Spears and Nick Singleton both inactive. He had 14 and 19 carries the two weeks before.
RB24 rest of season for me. Sell him on the three scores.

#DallasCowboys Javonte Williams, DAL RB: ran 25 times for 155 and a TD in the 38-21 win at PHI, his third straight game with a score.
RB8 rest of season for me. Sell him while the carries and scores are at their peak.

#WhoDey Tee Higgins, CIN WR: caught 6 of 7 targets for 148 and a TD at BAL. Ja'Marr Chase also drew 7 targets on the same 46 snaps. Higgins strained an adductor late in his 11-catch, 157-yard game vs JAX in Week 4.
WR16 rest of season for me. Sell him on the 148 yards.

#OnePride Jameson Williams, DET WR: caught 5 of 9 targets for 91 and 2 TDs vs GB, 29 percent of the throws, after 4, 8 and 4 targets in his three games before. Amon-Ra St.
WR23 rest of season for me. Sell him on the two scores.

#GoPackGo Christian Watson, GB WR: has drawn 8 targets in each of his last three games, his share fell from 26 percent to 19, and he scored in four of his first five games.
WR10 rest of season for me. Sell him before Thursday vs CAR.

#Seahawks Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB: ran 24 times for 100 and a TD vs KC on 48 percent of the snaps, with Zach Charbonnet inactive.
RB47 rest of season for me. Sell him while the 100 yards are fresh.

#HTownMade Woody Marks, HOU RB: played 54 of 61 snaps vs NYG and ran 19 times for 66, the only Houston back with a touch. He ran 15 times for 62 at TEN and 15 for 56 at JAX after David Montgomery hurt his groin in Week 5.
RB30 rest of season for me. Sell him during the bye.

#BroncosCountry Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR: played a season-low 56 percent of the snaps at ARI and caught 4 for 48, then left late in the fourth quarter with chest and left shoulder injuries.
WR39 rest of season for me. Sell him before Friday's injury report.

#PhinsUp Caleb Douglas, MIA WR: 2 TDs on 3 targets at NYJ, 14 percent of the throws.
WR52 rest of season for me. Sell him to the manager who claimed him.

Malik Willis, MIA QB: 21 throws in Miami's first win.
QB21 rest of season for me. Sell him on the first win.

#JetUp Geno Smith, NYJ QB: 3 TD passes vs MIA after 3 in his previous three games.
QB24 rest of season for me. Sell him after the three-TD week.

Mason Taylor, NYJ TE: 2 TDs on 6 targets, his first scores of the season.
TE31 rest of season for me. Sell him on the two scores.

The one trade to make today: #ChiefsKingdom Kenneth Walker III, while his manager stares at 36 yards from a game Kansas City never led. Same snaps, same share of the carries.

RB3 rest of season for me. Buy him.

Every buy and sell, with the reasons behind it, is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
